name: Selective-IGEV
plain: IGEV-Stereo with selective recurrent units, by Xianqi Wang et al., with checkpoints for several datasets.
summary: Selective-IGEV (Wang et al. 2024, Selective-Stereo): IGEV-Stereo with selective recurrent units, attention-blended small (1x1) and large (3x3) ConvGRUs on a channel- and spatially re-weighted context, 32 iterations.

papers.title: Selective-Stereo: Adaptive Frequency Information Selection for Stereo Matching

limitations: ONNX export needs torch >= 2.14 (older exporters fail on this network).
task_io: Input: a rectified left / right image pair. Output: a disparity map (pixels, left view).
